title: Tank level control with overflow protection
nl_spec: A storage tank has a measured level in percent (Level, 0..100). An inlet pump (PumpIn) fills the tank and an outlet valve (ValveOut) drains it. Maintain the level using hysteresis: turn the inlet pump ON when the level falls to or below the low limit (10%) and turn it OFF when the level rises to or above the high limit (90%). To prevent overflow, the outlet valve must open whenever the level is at or above the high limit. SAFETY: the inlet pump must never run while the level is at or above the high limit. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named tank_level with input Level and outputs PumpIn and ValveOut.

safety_properties.nl: The inlet pump never runs when the level is at or above the high limit (overflow prevention).
The outlet valve is open whenever the level is at or above the high limit.
The inlet pump and outlet valve are never energized at the same time.

scenarios.description: Fill below low, stop at high

notes: Numeric INT input bounded to [0,100] so the property is finite-state model-checkable. High=90, Low=10 are constants in the reference.
